title: PUFFBOY breaks limits with “Generational $uicide” an unfiltered song about pain and perseverance
htmlContent:
Rising artist PUFFBOY opens up in his latest single, "Generational $uicide" featuring $kit. This track shares his battles through powerful lyrics and haunting tunes. It's a major moment for PUFFBOY as it marks his first attempt at singing, adding a new depth to his artistic expression.

In "Generational $uicide," PUFFBOY shares his life experiences with emotion and honesty. The song touches on themes of generational pain and personal struggles, and it hits home because he speaks his truth without trying to soften the message. PUFFBOY combines sad melodies with a catchy rhythm, his move into singing shows his growth as an artist, highlighting his ability to express vulnerability rather than just bravado.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6BSb3KNHu1K2aZ8Xt3ktqD?si=WKV3rr1tRq-ZjeFB-MZ0tA

This song signifies a turning point for PUFFBOY in his career and how he shares his story. "Generational $uicide" is a way for listeners to face their own pain, confront their challenges, and find strength in overcoming them. PUFFBOY is pouring his heart out, and it's impossible not to feel his emotions in every note.
